title: kbmon's held-back count reads 0 after a delivery run that waited on CI or found the lock taken
goal: mon_querylog.held_back skips the outcomes of a delivery run that tried no delivery (ql_report.NO_DELIVERY) when it finds the last delivery's held-back line, so the panel keeps showing the files still held back

run:
import sys,os,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import mon_querylog as m, ql_distill; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); open(os.path.join(d,ql_distill.LOG_NAME),'w').write('apply --push: 1 file(s) held back in the local store, undelivered, retried at the next delivery:
  x:1: y
apply --push: pushed abc
apply --push: CI of the last automatic commit is pending
'); sys.exit(1 if m.held_back(d)==0 else 0)
